The emulator draws on a graphics card when one is passed in, the phone gets a working microphone and speaker, the back camera plays videos and flashing light, and `sk` can drive the GPS along a track, set a screen lock PIN and add a fingerprint. Apps that record sound, follow a route, read light signals or ask for a fingerprint can be tested now instead of being skipped.

The back camera's default changes from `picture` to `video`. QR codes still work the same way; `EMULATOR_CAMERA_BACK=picture` brings the old mode back.

## ✨ Added

- **A microphone with something to hear.** `sk mic <file>` plays a WAV, MP3, OGG or FLAC file into the phone's microphone, `--loop` repeats it, and `click-120-bpm` and the other click tracks are built in for metronome and tuner apps. Once you switch it on in the Selkies sidebar, the browser's own microphone reaches the phone too.
- **Videos and Morse light on the back camera.** `sk camera video <file>` plays an mp4 or webm in a loop, `sk camera blink SOS [wpm]` flashes the text as Morse code. QR codes and pictures from `sk camera` keep working and are shown as still videos.
- **`sk route <gpx>`** drives the GPS along a track at the pace its timestamps give, with altitude and speed, or with `--kmh`, `--speedup` and `--loop`. `sk route test-track` uses the track from `sk seed`.
- **`sk geo` takes an altitude** in metres as a third value.
- **`sk pin 1357`** sets a screen lock PIN and `sk pin off` removes it, so apps that need a secure lock screen can be set up without tapping through Settings.
- **`sk finger enroll`** adds a fingerprint through the Settings flow, and `sk finger touch` touches the sensor with it, for apps that unlock with a fingerprint.

## ⚡ Improved

- **GPU rendering by default.** `EMULATOR_GPU` defaults to `auto`. An NVIDIA card is used through `--runtime=nvidia` and `NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES`, Intel and AMD graphics through `--device=/dev/dri`, and without either the emulator falls back to SwiftShader on the CPU. Before this, it rendered on the CPU unless you changed a setting, so taps and scrolling lagged even on a box with a GPU. Tested on an RTX 4070 Ti SUPER and on Intel UHD 770 graphics; AMD takes the same Mesa path as Intel but has not been tested. An existing install keeps `swiftshader_indirect` from its template: set `EMULATOR_GPU` to `auto` and pass the card in to switch over.
- **The log names the renderer.** The READY block ends with a `Drawn:` line showing the renderer Android ended up on, so a card that never arrived is easy to spot.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **No sound in or out.** The emulator runs as its own user and could not open the socket PulseAudio keeps in a folder only root may enter, so its audio driver never started. The phone's sound did not reach the browser and the microphone was silent. The emulator now gets a socket of its own, and the start script creates it again if PulseAudio was restarted.
